stories.title: Mobilisation des lycéens, législatives anticipées en Espagne, prix Nobel de médecine… L’actu de ce lundi 5 octobre

en.title: High school mobilization, snap legislative elections in Spain, medicine Nobel Prize… Today's news on Monday, October 5
en.summary: A news digest covering major events from Monday, October 5, including high school student protests, Spanish legislative elections, and the Nobel Prize in Medicine.

stories.title: EN DIRECT – Blocus des lycées : 190 élèves blessés depuis le début du mouvement de contestation, annonce Edouard Geffray

en.title: LIVE – High school blockades: 190 students injured since start of protest movement, announces Edouard Geffray
en.summary: High school protests involving violence resumed Monday with a blockade planned for Tuesday. The government proposes five policy initiatives while defending its handling of the situation.

stories.title: Blocages des lycées : 190 élèves et personnels ont été blessés depuis le début du mouvement, selon le ministre de l'Education

en.title: High school blockades: 190 students and staff injured since start of movement, according to Education Minister
en.summary: The Education Minister visited a high school in Yvelines a week after high school protests began, confirming casualty figures from the ongoing movement.

stories.title: EN DIRECT - Blocus des lycées : 190 élèves ont été blessés depuis le début du mouvement, indique Édouard Geffray

en.title: LIVE – High school blockades: 190 students injured since start of movement, says Édouard Geffray
en.summary: A 15-year-old student sustained a severe hand injury Monday after picking up a grenade during a protest in Lens, according to local authorities investigating the incident.

stories.title: EN DIRECT, blocage des lycées : Edouard Geffray estime « humainement dramatique » le fait qu’un lycéen de 15 ans ait eu une main arrachée à Lens

en.title: LIVE UPDATES: school blockades; Edouard Geffray calls 15-year-old student losing hand in Lens "humanly catastrophic"
en.summary: On Monday, 589 French schools were disrupted by student protests, down from 735 on Friday. High school students plan further demonstrations on Tuesday, with backing from political figures and unions.

stories.title: Blocage des lycées : à Lens, un adolescent a eu la main arrachée en ramassant une grenade lors d’affrontements avec la police

en.title: School blockades: in Lens, a teenager lost his hand after picking up a grenade during clashes with police
en.summary: A police source indicates a teenager lost his hand after retrieving a dispersal grenade to throw back at officers during school-related protests in Lens.

stories.title: Un adolescent de 15 ans a eu "la main arrachée" par une grenade près d'un lycée de Lens, une enquête de l'IGPN ouverte

en.title: 15-year-old student had hand severed by grenade near school in Lens; police inspectorate opens investigation
en.summary: A 15-year-old student attending Auguste-Béhal vocational school in Lens, Pas-de-Calais, suffered severe injury during Monday's school-related disturbances, triggering an official inquiry.

stories.title: A Lens, un lycéen a eu une main arrachée, l’IGPN saisie

en.title: In Lens, a high school student lost his hand; police inspectorate investigates
en.summary: A 15-year-old second-year student was injured by a grenade on Monday during school disturbances in Lens; circumstances remain unclear and prosecutors have referred the case for investigation.

stories.title: Prix Nobel de médecine 2026 : les neurosciences à l’honneur

en.title: 2026 Nobel Prize in Medicine: neuroscience honored
en.summary: Three German and American researchers won the Nobel Prize in Medicine for developing techniques to control targeted cell activity, particularly neurons, using light.

stories.title: Le prix Nobel de médecine 2026 décerné aux chercheurs Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann et Georg Nagel, pour avoir posé "les fondements d'une nouvelle ère en neurosciences"

en.title: 2026 Nobel Prize in Medicine awarded to researchers Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel for laying "the foundations of a new era in neuroscience"
en.summary: The three researchers were honored for their discoveries concerning light-activated ion channels and optogenetics, a method that demonstrates how nerve cells shape memory, emotion and behavior in the living brain.

stories.title: 🔴 Le prix Nobel de médecine est décerné à Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann et Georg Nagel

en.title: Nobel Prize in Medicine awarded to Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel
en.summary: Three scientists were awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Medicine for their research contributions.

stories.title: Le Nobel de médecine 2026 récompense l’Américain Karl Deisseroth et les Allemands Peter Hegemann et Georg Nagel pour leurs travaux sur les canaux ioniques

en.title: 2026 Nobel Prize in Medicine Honors American Karl Deisseroth and Germans Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel for Work on Ion Channels
en.summary: Three scientists received the Nobel Prize in Medicine for discovering a method to demonstrate how nerve cells shape memory, emotion, and behavior in the brain.

stories.title: Vendre les actifs non stratégiques de la Caisse des dépôts : la Cour des comptes cible un portefeuille de 31,6 milliards

en.title: Court of Auditors targets Caisse des dépôts non-strategic assets worth 31.6 billion euros for sale
en.summary: France's Court of Auditors is urging the Caisse des dépôts to divest non-strategic holdings valued at 31.6 billion euros in 2026 and return proceeds to the state while preserving group revenues.

stories.title: Dette publique : comment la restructuration d’un État frappe les ménages modestes

en.title: Public Debt: How State Restructuring Affects Modest Households
en.summary: When states default on debt, modest households bear the heaviest costs through reduced credit availability, degraded public services, and employment threats, rather than bondholders.
